hints.title: Substrings Partition Check
hints.text: For each integer i from 1 to n, square it and convert the square to its decimal string.

hints.title: Partition Recursion
hints.text: Recursively split the squared string into contiguous numerical chunks and check if their sum can equal i.

hints.title: Accumulate Valid Squares
hints.text: If a valid partition sum matching i exists, add i * i to the total punishment score.

hints.title: Backtracking Partition Implementation

variables: D: maximum number of digits of i^2 (at most 7)
complexity.notes: Backtracking recursion over substring cuts for small digit lengths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partitioning is required as digits cannot be rearranged.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs simple string-cut recursion with pruning when the partition exceeds target.
